title.narrative: Rapid Social Response Multi Donor Trust Fund

description.narrative: The objective of the trust fund is to support countries in their development and expansion of robust, responsive and equitable social protection systems to build resilience to shocks and expand sustaianable economic opportunities among poor and vulnerable households and communities. The support from Norad has an expressed preference for activities under a new window on food and nutrition security.
